tagline.en: China Mobile's UK service on EE, with a second mainland number attached
tagline.zh: 中国移动在英国做的 EE 卡，自带一个国内副号

description.en: CMLink UK is China Mobile International's MVNO on EE, built for students and people shuttling between the UK and China. As of September 2026 the entry point is a £1 trial SIM (1GB UK data, 30 minutes, 30 SMS, 30 days, free postage); standard activation needs a £2 top-up, though that figure was not re-confirmed on public pages. Keep the line by ordering a new bundle within 90 days on monthly or annual plans, or 30 days on travel bundles. Best value is £19 for 90 days with 40GB of China-roaming data. First activation must happen in the UK or EU.
description.zh: CMLink UK 是中国移动国际在英国做的虚商，走 EE 网络，面向留学生和中英往返的人。2026 年 9 月的入口是 1 英镑体验包（1GB 英国流量、30 分钟、30 条短信、30 天，免邮）；标准激活首充 2 英镑，但这个数字没能在公开页面再次核实。月付和年包到期后 90 天内、旅游包到期后 30 天内续订新套餐才能保号。最划算的是 19 英镑 90 天、含 40GB 回国流量。首次激活必须在英国或欧盟。

details.en:
CMLink UK is the pick when your traffic is China-bound: mainland-China roaming rides EE's network with a native UK IP, mainland apps like TikTok work normally while roaming, and bundle prices are fixed and repeat-orderable. Its signature is one-card-two-numbers — a UK number plus a Chinese secondary number for receiving SMS and verification codes in mainland China.

Acquisition flow (2026-03 review): pick a bundle on the official site, choose eSIM as the SIM type at checkout (the direct eSIM option has been removed from the storefront at times — order the physical SIM and convert via customer service if absent), fill in email/name/phone, agree to terms, pay, and receive the eSIM QR code by email.

Activation must happen with signal in the UK or EU (mainland China activation is not supported; Hong Kong activation has been reported unreliable).

Number-keeping: monthly/annual bundles — auto-cancellation after 90 consecutive days without a new bundle; travel/China/one-off/keep-alive/trial bundles — 30 days (the 30-day one-off rule was re-confirmed verbatim on planlist 2026-09; the 90-day monthly/annual rule was not re-found on public pages that round — likely lives in the product T&C PDFs). 5G supported, data quality rated better than CTExcel's, and it is the better choice of the two Chinese-operator UK brands for receiving mainland verification codes.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified, likely a third-party channel price): a $7.9/year tier with 10GB high-speed plus one year of unlimited 512kbps low-speed data; mainland-China roaming lands on a Hong Kong native residential IP, with Singapore split routing over broadcast + residential IPs — well suited to AI subscriptions and cheap backup. Note: this price does not match official monthly plans; treat as third-party/promo and verify at the official store.
details.zh:
如果主要需求是「回国可用」，CMLink UK 是首选：中国大陆漫游走 EE 网络、英国原生 IP，漫游时 TikTok 等大陆应用可正常使用，套餐可重复订购且价格固定。招牌是一卡双号——英国号码 + 中国副号，方便在内地接收短信验证码。

获取流程（2026-03 盘点口径）：官网选套餐、结账时 SIM 类型直接选 eSIM（官网购买页没有常驻 eSIM 选项时，可先订实体卡再联系人工客服转 eSIM）、填写邮箱姓名电话、同意条款支付后，eSIM 二维码发送到邮箱。

激活须在英国或欧盟当地有信号后进行——不支持中国内地激活，也有用户反馈香港无法激活，规划行程时要预留激活窗口。

保号规则：月套餐/年包套餐到期后连续 90 天未订购新套餐销户；旅游/回国/一次性/保号/体验套餐到期后连续 30 天销户（2026-09 复查：30 天一次性套餐规则在官网 planlist 原文确认；90 天月/年包规则未在公开页重现，疑在产品条款 PDF 内）。支持 5G，数据质量在两家中国运营商英国卡中更好，接收内地验证码场景首选。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实，注意疑似第三方渠道口径）：年付 7.9 美元档含 10GB 高速流量+一年期 512kbps 不限速低速流量；中国大陆漫游落地为香港家庭原生 IP，新加坡分流为广播 IP+住宅 IP，适合 AI 订阅与日常备用，性价比极高。注：该价格与官网月套餐口径不符，疑似第三方/促销渠道，购买前以官方订购页为准。

bestFor.en: Students and anyone who needs both a UK number and a mainland secondary number for SMS codes.
bestFor.zh: 留学生，以及同时需要英国号和国内副号收验证码的人。

en: UK number + Chinese secondary number on one SIM
Native UK EE IP while roaming in mainland China
£1 trial SIM listed 2026-09; standard activation £2+ top-up, in UK/EU only
zh: 一卡双号：英国号码+中国副号
中国大陆漫游为EE原生英国IP
2026-09在售1英镑体验套餐；标准激活首充至少2英镑，须在英国/欧盟激活

plansNote.en: Plan terms per CMLink UK official pages (2026-03 review; re-checked 2026-09-16: £19/90-day China bundle and the 30-day one-off deactivation rule confirmed, £1 trial SIM now listed, £2 activation top-up and the 90-day monthly/annual rule not re-found on public pages). Activation location restrictions apply.
plansNote.zh: 套餐口径来自CMLink UK官网（2026-03盘点；2026-09-16复查：£19/90天回国包与一次性套餐30天销户规则已确认，新增1英镑体验套餐在售，£2首充与月/年包90天规则未在公开页重现）；激活地有限制条款。

en: One card, two numbers, so mainland SMS verification is handled
Mainland roaming on EE is stable and keeps a native UK IP
5G works, and fixed-price bundles can be re-ordered
£1 trial SIM as of September 2026, and activation only needs £2
zh: 一卡双号，内地验证码直接解决
EE 网络内地漫游稳定，落地是原生英国 IP
支持 5G，固定价格套餐可重复订购
2026 年 9 月有 1 英镑体验包，激活首充只要 2 英镑

en: Must activate in the UK or EU; mainland China does not work and Hong Kong is unreliable
The eSIM option on the storefront comes and goes, sometimes support has to convert it
30 days to re-order on one-off bundles is a tight window
The $7.9/year tier circulating in forums is not on official pages, so verify the channel first
zh: 必须在英国或欧盟激活，内地不行，香港不稳
官网 eSIM 选项时有时无，有时要让客服帮忙转卡
一次性套餐只有 30 天续订窗口，比较紧
论坛流传的 7.9 美元年付档官网没有，买之前先核实渠道

country.en: GB in UK (via EE); HK reported when roaming in mainland China; SG for Singapore plans (community)
country.zh: 在英国为 GB（走 EE）；内地漫游有报告落在香港；新加坡套餐落 SG（社区口径）

note.en: China Mobile International MVNO on EE UK. Community/reseller channels (DocOfCard Telegram, YouTube sellers) consistently describe the UK IP as native and clean, often classified residential by IP databases; the China-roaming-via-HK-home-IP and Singapore claims come from community word-of-mouth without public test logs.
note.zh: 中国移动国际旗下、EE 英国网 MVNO。社区/卡商渠道（DocOfCard 电报、YouTube 卡商）一致称其英国 IP 原生纯净、常被 IP 库判为住宅；「漫游中国落地香港家庭 IP」「新加坡广播+住宅」均为社区口碑，无公开实测日志，故整体 low。
